case selection.other archived starts: Every fiftieth non-tree-shaped census start with a C4 record, in archive order, and the first closed census start.

exact explanations.projection: At any finite reached stage each old state's mass under projected equal weighting is its number of extensions divided by the total stage count.
exact explanations.one-round product: Each fresh distinction appears in only one birth. For p old inputs and f fresh distinctions a birth has 2^f completions minus one if all its inputs agree. Multiply over the births.
exact explanations.positive factors: Equivalently every factor is (2^f - 1) plus the indicator that its inputs are not all equal. An offshoot has a constant factor.
exact explanations.signed factors: For a birth of a = p + f places, the local factor after forgetting its fresh distinctions is proportional to the constant 2^(a-1)-1 minus the sum of all nonempty even sign products on its old inputs. The same expansion with p = a applies to original knots.
exact explanations.conditional test: Given all values of the middle knot of the three-knot chain, any product of factors confined to old knots separates the paid distinctions of the two outer knots. The projected stage has a conditional odds ratio 9/16 there. Deleting only the two-parent birth law restores ratio 1.
exact explanations.availability: The replay marks stalled and closed starts separately. Their literal count is an identity-stage control. The stipulated completion analysis omits them.
